evidence: A motorized soft roller cleaner head and lower wand connector are visible.
missing_evidence: Main motor body, cyclone assembly, dust bin, and handle controls are out of frame.
decision.retake: Capture a clear photo of the main vacuum body showing the cyclone assembly and bin.

candidate_checks.evidence: The main body and cyclone assembly are out of frame, leaving the machine indistinguishable from other models sharing this cleaner head.
The motor body and compression mechanism are not visible, so the cleaner head alone cannot confirm or exclude V16.
The canister body is out of frame, and the presence of a floor head alone cannot confirm or contradict a cylinder vacuum.
The slim motor body, bin, and push-button controls are completely out of frame.
The in-line bin, trigger handle, and rear display are out of frame.
The visible single soft roller head and quick-release wand joint are incompatible with the WashG1 dual-roller wet floor cleaner.

o1.refinement_reason: Inspect the main body and cyclone assembly to determine the exact machine family.
